s0001.literal: Third year, spring, first month, guiwei new moon: Siam, Melaiyou, Luohu, and other states each presented local products in tribute; the Siam crown prince was granted a tiger tally.
s0001.idiomatic: Third year, spring, first month, guiwei new moon: Siam, Melaiyou, Luohu, and other states each presented local products in tribute; the Siam crown prince was granted a tiger tally.

s0002.literal: On bingxu day the moon encroached upon Venus.
s0002.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon encroached upon Venus.

s0003.literal: On jichou day central secretariat officials said: "Heavenly portents have repeatedly appeared; great ministers ought according to precedent to acknowledge blame and yield their posts.
s0003.idiomatic: On jichou day central secretariat officials said, "Heavenly portents have repeatedly appeared; great ministers ought according to precedent to acknowledge blame and yield their posts.

s0004.literal: The Emperor said: "This is what Han people say — how can We heed it one by one?
s0004.idiomatic: The Emperor said, "This is what Han people say — how can We heed it one by one?

s0005.literal: You need only appoint those who are suitable.
s0005.idiomatic: You need only appoint those who are suitable.

s0006.literal: " On gengyin day an edict dispatched envoys to inquire into the people's hardships.
s0006.idiomatic: On gengyin day an edict dispatched envoys to inquire into the people's hardships.

s0007.literal: The corvée purchase of wrapped silver and salary notes within the capital region for this year was abolished; three-tenths of Jiangnan summer tax was remitted; salary rice for junior clerks was increased.
s0007.idiomatic: The corvée purchase of wrapped silver and salary notes within the capital region for this year was abolished; three-tenths of Jiangnan summer tax was remitted; salary rice for junior clerks was increased.

s0008.literal: Benefit-the-People Bureaus were established on each route, with skilled physicians selected to preside over them.
s0008.idiomatic: Benefit-the-People Bureaus were established on each route, with skilled physicians selected to preside over them.

s0009.literal: Yaomuhu'er was enfeoffed as Prince of Dingyuan and granted a gold seal.
s0009.idiomatic: Yaomuhu'er was enfeoffed as Prince of Dingyuan and granted a gold seal.

s0010.literal: The central secretariat was ordered: from now on what consorts, imperial princesses, and princes require must not be supplied without receiving an imperial order;
s0010.idiomatic: The central secretariat was ordered: from now on what consorts, imperial princesses, and princes require must not be supplied without receiving an imperial order;

s0011.literal: those who on their own authority established offices and confused the selection regulations were admonished.
s0011.idiomatic: those who on their own authority established offices and confused the selection regulations were admonished.

s0012.literal: On xinmao day an edict ordered each branch secretariat carefully to inspect sick soldiers in each wing.
s0012.idiomatic: On xinmao day an edict ordered each branch secretariat carefully to inspect sick soldiers in each wing.

s0013.literal: Wang Yu, surveillance commissioner of Western Zhejiang, committed corruption; relying on a favorite he sought exemption; the censorate was ordered to try him.
s0013.idiomatic: Wang Yu, surveillance commissioner of Western Zhejiang, committed corruption; relying on a favorite he sought exemption; the censorate was ordered to try him.

s0014.literal: On renchen day Koryo attendant ministers Zhao Rengui was resettled in Anxi and Cui Chongshao in Gongchang; both were flogged and dismissed, to rectify their crime of following King Chon in killing persons on his own authority; Wang Ju was restored as king of Koryo; Minister of Works Yesi Temür and Hanlin awaiting edict drafter Jia Ruzhou were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct him.
s0014.idiomatic: On renchen day Koryo attendant ministers Zhao Rengui was resettled in Anxi and Cui Chongshao in Gongchang; both were flogged and dismissed, to rectify their crime of following King Chon in killing persons on his own authority; Wang Ju was restored as king of Koryo; minister of works Yesi Temür and Hanlin awaiting edict drafter Jia Ruzhou were dispatched bearing an edict to instruct him.

s0015.literal: The campaign seals of Bietemuer and Tuotuhe'erlu were recalled.
s0015.idiomatic: The campaign seals of Bietemuer and Tuotuhe'erlu were recalled.

s0016.literal: Central secretariat officials said: "In recent years what the public treasury has expended often runs to tens of thousands; the annual revenue suffices for less than half a year — the remainder is all borrowed and paid from note reserves.
s0016.idiomatic: Central secretariat officials said, "In recent years what the public treasury has expended often runs to tens of thousands; the annual revenue suffices for less than half a year — the remainder is all borrowed and paid from note reserves.

s0017.literal: Your subject fears that if finances are mismanaged, the note system will also be ruined.
s0017.idiomatic: Your subject fears that if finances are mismanaged, the note system will also be ruined.

s0018.literal: " The Emperor praised and accepted this.
s0018.idiomatic: The Emperor praised and accepted this.

s0019.literal: They were also ordered to instruct Ochicharu and others that from now on all grants and gifts must not be memorialized.
s0019.idiomatic: They were also ordered to instruct Ochicharu and others that from now on all grants and gifts must not be memorialized.

s0020.literal: On guisi day, because Jiangnan army rolls had many gaps and officials took advantage to commit fraud, an edict forbade and rectified this.
s0020.idiomatic: On guisi day, because Jiangnan army rolls had many gaps and officials took advantage to commit fraud, an edict forbade and rectified this.

s0021.literal: Darqan Harqasun was made left chancellor of the central secretariat.
s0021.idiomatic: Darqan Harqasun was made left chancellor of the central secretariat.

s0022.literal: On dingyou day the moon encroached upon the Western Rampart Upper General.
s0022.idiomatic: On dingyou day the moon encroached upon the Western Rampart Upper General.

s0023.literal: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.
s0023.idiomatic: On wuxu day the moon encroached upon the Right Enforcer.

s0024.literal: On xinchou day horses on all routes were registered; those enrolled in Mongol army rolls were exempted.
s0024.idiomatic: On xinchou day horses on all routes were registered; those enrolled in Mongol army rolls were exempted.

s0025.literal: On yisi day Venus crossed the sky.
s0025.idiomatic: On yisi day Venus crossed the sky.

s0026.literal: Second month, guichou new moon: the imperial carriage proceeded to Willow Grove.
s0026.idiomatic: Second month, guichou new moon: the imperial carriage proceeded to Willow Grove.

s0027.literal: On dingsi day Wanze and others memorialized on fixing provincial and ministry offices; they were introduced in order and the Emperor approved all; he also instructed the Six Ministries officials, saying: "Your affairs are often delayed and mistaken; We formerly did not know who the persons were.
s0027.idiomatic: On dingsi day Wanze and others memorialized on fixing provincial and ministry offices; they were introduced in order and the Emperor approved all; he also instructed the Six Ministries officials, saying, "Your affairs are often delayed and mistaken; We formerly did not know who the persons were.

s0028.literal: Now that We have reviewed them and know their names, cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts — each respect your office.
s0028.idiomatic: Now that We have reviewed them and know their names, cleanse your hearts and wash away your thoughts — each respect your office.

s0029.literal: If you again repeat former faults, punishment will not spare you.
s0029.idiomatic: If you again repeat former faults, punishment will not spare you.

s0030.literal: " The Sichuan and Fujian branch secretariats were abolished; the Shaanxi branch censorate was abolished; the Jiangdong, Jingnan, and Huaixi pacification commissions were abolished.
s0030.idiomatic: The Sichuan and Fujian branch secretariats were abolished; the Shaanxi branch censorate was abolished; the Jiangdong, Jingnan, and Huaixi pacification commissions were abolished.

s0031.literal: The Sichuan and Fujian pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters and the Shaanxi Hanzhong Circuit Surveillance Commission were established.
s0031.idiomatic: The Sichuan and Fujian pacification commission commander-in-chief headquarters and the Shaanxi Hanzhong Circuit Surveillance Commission were established.

s0032.literal: Karakorum and Ganzhou city were expanded.
s0032.idiomatic: Karakorum and Ganzhou city were expanded.

s0033.literal: An edict ordered that Jishan County householders shielded by powerful families all be restored to county registration.
s0033.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Jishan County householders shielded by powerful families all be restored to county registration.

s0034.literal: On renxu day an edict instructed the civil and military populations of Jiang-Zhe and Henan North provinces.
s0034.idiomatic: On renxu day an edict instructed the civil and military populations of Jiang-Zhe and Henan North provinces.

s0035.literal: On yisi day Mars encroached upon the Five Dukes.
s0035.idiomatic: On yisi day Mars encroached upon the Five Dukes.

s0036.literal: On renshen day the Salt Pond Spirit Lord Huikang of Jie Prefecture was further titled Guangji; the Precious Treasure Lord Yongze;
s0036.idiomatic: On renshen day the Salt Pond Spirit Lord Huikang of Jie Prefecture was further titled Guangji; the Precious Treasure Lord Yongze;

s0037.literal: the Sea Spirit of Quanzhou Protect-the-Realm and Shelter-the-People Brightly Manifest Heavenly Consort;
s0037.idiomatic: the Sea Spirit of Quanzhou Protect-the-Realm and Shelter-the-People Brightly Manifest Heavenly Consort;

s0038.literal: the Sea Spirit of Yan Guan Prefecture in Western Zhejiang Spirit-perceiving Broadly Auspicious Lord;
s0038.idiomatic: the Sea Spirit of Yan Guan Prefecture in Western Zhejiang Spirit-perceiving Broadly Auspicious Lord;

s0039.literal: Wu Yuan, grandee of Wu, Loyalty, Filial Piety, Authority, Kindness, and Manifest Sagely King.
s0039.idiomatic: Wu Yuan, grandee of Wu, Loyalty, Filial Piety, Authority, Kindness, and Manifest Sagely King.

s0040.literal: Gold Teeth sent envoys presenting local products.
s0040.idiomatic: Gold Teeth sent envoys presenting local products.

s0041.literal: On gengchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.
s0041.idiomatic: On gengchen day the imperial carriage proceeded to Shangdu.

s0042.literal: Third month, on guisi day Burma crown prince Xinhebade presented a memorial thanking the court for granted robes and was dismissed to return.
s0042.idiomatic: Third month, on guisi day Burma crown prince Xinhebade presented a memorial thanking the court for granted robes and was dismissed to return.

s0043.literal: Master Miaoci Hongji, Jiang-Zhe Buddhist chief prelate, Putuo Ning Yishan, was ordered to bear an edict as envoy to Japan; the edict said: "The relevant offices memorialized: formerly Emperor Shizu dispatched Putuo Chan monk Ruzhi and Wang Jiweng and others twice to bear seal letters and open friendly relations with Japan — all met obstruction midway and returned.
s0043.idiomatic: Master Miaoci Hongji, Jiang-Zhe Buddhist chief prelate, Putuo Ning Yishan, was ordered to bear an edict as envoy to Japan; the edict said, "The relevant offices memorialized: formerly Emperor Shizu dispatched Putuo Chan monk Ruzhi and Wang Jiweng and others twice to bear seal letters and open friendly relations with Japan — all met obstruction midway and returned.

s0044.literal: Since We began to rule, We have pacified and embraced all states; within and beyond the distant seas none has been left behind — friendly relations with Japan ought to be reopened.
s0044.idiomatic: Since We began to rule, We have pacified and embraced all states; within and beyond the distant seas none has been left behind — friendly relations with Japan ought to be reopened.

s0045.literal: Now Ruzhi is old; the Putuo monk Yishan has long been of lofty conduct — he may be sent to instruct them, traveling attached to merchant vessels, so that he may certainly arrive.
s0045.idiomatic: Now Ruzhi is old; the Putuo monk Yishan has long been of lofty conduct — he may be sent to instruct them, traveling attached to merchant vessels, so that he may certainly arrive.

s0046.literal: We specially accede to their request, intending only to fulfill the former emperor's remaining wish.
s0046.idiomatic: We specially accede to their request, intending only to fulfill the former emperor's remaining wish.

s0047.literal: As for matters of sincere friendship and giving the people rest, the king should carefully plan them.
s0047.idiomatic: As for matters of sincere friendship and giving the people rest, the king should carefully plan them.

s0048.literal: " On jiawu day He Rongzu and others were ordered to revise the statutes and ordinances.
s0048.idiomatic: On jiawu day He Rongzu and others were ordered to revise the statutes and ordinances.

s0049.literal: An edict ordered: military officers guilty of corruption — the serious cases dismissed from office, lighter cases reduced in titular rank, or punished and allowed to remain in office without salary, for one year permitted to redeem themselves.
s0049.idiomatic: An edict ordered: military officers guilty of corruption — the serious cases dismissed from office, lighter cases reduced in titular rank, or punished and allowed to remain in office without salary, for one year permitted to redeem themselves.

s0050.literal: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Ghost.
s0050.idiomatic: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Ghost.

s0051.literal: The Censorate Palace Bureau was promoted to fifth rank.
s0051.idiomatic: The Censorate Palace Bureau was promoted to fifth rank.

s0052.literal: On yisi day the branch censorate impeached pingzhang Jiaohua for accepting thirty thousand-odd ingots; Jiaohua further reported that when pingzhang Dirbuhua was in charge of revenues he embezzled three hundred thousand ingots, and branch censorate vice commissioner Zhang Lü accepted one hundred ingots from Li Yuanshan; an edict ordered all not to be inquired into.
s0052.idiomatic: On yisi day the branch censorate impeached pingzhang Jiaohua for accepting 30,000-odd ingots; Jiaohua further reported that when pingzhang Dirbuhua was in charge of revenues he embezzled 300,000 ingots, and branch censorate vice commissioner Zhang Lü accepted 100 ingots from Li Yuanshan; an edict ordered all not to be inquired into.

s0053.literal: On wushen day one surveillance commissioner for Jiangnan routes was reduced; Karakorum army was granted one hundred thousand ingots of notes.
s0053.idiomatic: On wushen day one surveillance commissioner for Jiangnan routes was reduced; Karakorum army was granted 100,000 ingots of notes.

s0054.literal: Summer, fourth month, xinhai new moon: because imperial son-in-law Manzitai's following was destitute, one hundred thirty thousand shi of grain was distributed in relief.
s0054.idiomatic: Summer, fourth month, xinhai new moon: because imperial son-in-law Manzitai's following was destitute, 130,000 shi of grain was distributed in relief.

s0055.literal: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Upper General.
s0055.idiomatic: On jiwei day the moon encroached upon Upper General.

s0056.literal: On bingyin day Saturn encroached upon Ghost, and the moon encroached upon Heart.
s0056.idiomatic: On bingyin day Saturn encroached upon Ghost, and the moon encroached upon Heart.

s0057.literal: On gengwu day the ban on private salt in Jiang-Zhe and the Two Huai was strictly enforced; patrolling officers were promoted and rewarded according to seizures.
s0057.idiomatic: On gengwu day the ban on private salt in Jiang-Zhe and the Two Huai was strictly enforced; patrolling officers were promoted and rewarded according to seizures.

s0058.literal: On xinwei day Karakorum garrison troops were forbidden to insert false names into other registers.
s0058.idiomatic: On xinwei day Karakorum garrison troops were forbidden to insert false names into other registers.

s0059.literal: From Tong Prefecture to the Two Huai grain-transport river, nineteen patrol offices for river defense and bandit capture were established in all.
s0059.idiomatic: From Tong Prefecture to the Two Huai grain-transport river, 19 patrol offices for river defense and bandit capture were established in all.

s0060.literal: On jimao day Minister of Rites Yuegu Buhua was made left vice director of the central secretariat.
s0060.idiomatic: On jimao day minister of rites Yuegu Buhua was made left vice director of the central secretariat.

s0061.literal: Karakorum army was granted five hundred thousand ingots of notes, four hundred thousand bolts of silks, and twenty thousand shi of grain; the Karakorum pacification commission was still ordered to purchase five thousand horses and supply them.
s0061.idiomatic: Karakorum army was granted 500,000 ingots of notes, 400,000 bolts of silks, and 20,000 shi of grain; the Karakorum pacification commission was still ordered to purchase 5,000 horses and supply them.

s0062.literal: Mongols, Jurchens, and others in Kaiyuan and Xianping in Liaodong lacked food; twenty thousand five hundred shi of grain and three thousand nine hundred bolts of cloth were distributed in relief.
s0062.idiomatic: Mongols, Jurchens, and others in Kaiyuan and Xianping in Liaodong lacked food; 20,500 shi of grain and 3,900 bolts of cloth were distributed in relief.

s0063.literal: Fifth month, on renwu day Jiangnan Buddhist chief prelate offices on all routes were abolished.
s0063.idiomatic: Fifth month, on renwu day Jiangnan Buddhist chief prelate offices on all routes were abolished.

s0064.literal: On bingshen day the moon encroached upon Southern Dipper.
s0064.idiomatic: On bingshen day the moon encroached upon Southern Dipper.

s0065.literal: Various tribes of Hainan including Sugutai, Sulongtan, and Benxili presented tigers, elephants, and sago-palm wood boats in tribute.
s0065.idiomatic: Various tribes of Hainan including Sugutai, Sulongtan, and Benxili presented tigers, elephants, and sago-palm wood boats in tribute.

s0066.literal: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Net.
s0066.idiomatic: On jihai day Venus encroached upon Net.

s0067.literal: On gengzi day half the annual grain levy from Yesudai'er's pasture lands in Shandong was remitted; the Aral tribe was forbidden to pasture horses at Guangping.
s0067.idiomatic: On gengzi day half the annual grain levy from Yesudai'er's pasture lands in Shandong was remitted; the Aral tribe was forbidden to pasture horses at Guangping.

s0068.literal: On gengzi day the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was restored; pingzhang of Fujian Pinghai Province Kuolijisi was made pingzhang.
s0068.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Eastern Expedition branch secretariat was restored; pingzhang of Fujian Pinghai Province Kuolijisi was made pingzhang.

s0069.literal: That month E, Yue, Hanyang, Xingguo, Chang, Li, Tan, Heng, Chen, Yuan, Baqing, Changning, Guiyang, and Chaling suffered drought — their liquor tax and summer tax were remitted;
s0069.idiomatic: That month E, Yue, Hanyang, Xingguo, Chang, Li, Tan, Heng, Chen, Yuan, Baqing, Changning, Guiyang, and Chaling suffered drought — their liquor tax and summer tax were remitted;

s0070.literal: Jiangling Circuit suffered drought and locusts — the ban on lakes was relaxed;
s0070.idiomatic: Jiangling Circuit suffered drought and locusts — the ban on lakes was relaxed;

s0071.literal: grain was still distributed in relief for all.
s0071.idiomatic: grain was still distributed in relief for all.

s0072.literal: Sixth month, on xinhai day Uludun Qingtong killed fleeing soldiers under his command on his own authority; the Privy Council was ordered to admonish him.
s0072.idiomatic: Sixth month, on xinhai day Uludun Qingtong killed fleeing soldiers under his command on his own authority; the Privy Council was ordered to admonish him.

s0073.literal: On guichou day the rent on old Yellow River channel fields presented by Daming Route was abolished.
s0073.idiomatic: On guichou day the rent on old Yellow River channel fields presented by Daming Route was abolished.

s0074.literal: On wuwu day the ban on sea merchants transporting men, horses, arms, and armor to various foreign states to trade was strictly enforced.
s0074.idiomatic: On wuwu day the ban on sea merchants transporting men, horses, arms, and armor to various foreign states to trade was strictly enforced.

s0075.literal: Because officials of Fujian prefectures and counties were mostly Semuren and Southerners, an order directed that from now on Han people be appointed jointly.
s0075.idiomatic: Because officials of Fujian prefectures and counties were mostly Semuren and Southerners, an order directed that from now on Han people be appointed jointly.

s0076.literal: Fujian commoners were forbidden to pose as tenants of powerful families to evade gate-service levies.
s0076.idiomatic: Fujian commoners were forbidden to pose as tenants of powerful families to evade gate-service levies.

s0077.literal: On gengshen day the moon eclipsed Fang.
s0077.idiomatic: On gengshen day the moon eclipsed Fang.

s0078.literal: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer.
s0078.idiomatic: On dingmao day Mars encroached upon the Right Enforcer.

s0079.literal: On renshen day Jupiter was visible in daytime.
s0079.idiomatic: On renshen day Jupiter was visible in daytime.

s0080.literal: Karakorum garrison troops were granted one million four hundred thousand ingots of notes; falconers were granted five hundred one thousand-odd ingots.
s0080.idiomatic: Karakorum garrison troops were granted 1,400,000 ingots of notes; falconers were granted 501,000-odd ingots.

s0081.literal: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao new moon Venus encroached upon Well.
s0081.idiomatic: Autumn, seventh month, on jimao new moon Venus encroached upon Well.

s0082.literal: On gengchen day central secretariat officials said: "More than five hundred thousand tenant households of monasteries in Jiangnan — all were originally registered commoners; since Yang Zongzhe improperly entered them into monastic registers, rectification should be applied.
s0082.idiomatic: On gengchen day central secretariat officials said, "More than 500,000 tenant households of monasteries in Jiangnan — all were originally registered commoners; since Yang Zongzhe improperly entered them into monastic registers, rectification should be applied.

s0084.literal: On bingchen day locusts struck Yangzhou and Huai'an subordinate counties; those on the ground were eaten by cormorants, and those flying were struck dead with wings; an edict forbade capturing cormorants.
s0084.idiomatic: On bingchen day locusts struck Yangzhou and Huai'an subordinate counties; those on the ground were eaten by cormorants, and those flying were struck dead with wings; an edict forbade capturing cormorants.

s0085.literal: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon Ghost.
s0085.idiomatic: On dingwei day the moon encroached upon Ghost.

s0086.literal: Eighth month, on jiyou new moon there was a solar eclipse.
s0086.idiomatic: Eighth month, on jiyou new moon there was a solar eclipse.

s0087.literal: On dingsi day the moon encroached upon Ji.
s0087.idiomatic: On dingsi day the moon encroached upon Ji.

s0088.literal: On wuchen day Venus encroached upon the great star of Xuan Yuan.
s0088.idiomatic: On wuchen day Venus encroached upon the great star of Xuan Yuan.

s0089.literal: On jisi day the moon encroached upon the Five Chariots.
s0089.idiomatic: On jisi day the moon encroached upon the Five Chariots.

s0090.literal: Prince of Dingyuan Yaomuhu'er's following was granted fifteen thousand ingots of notes.
s0090.idiomatic: Prince of Dingyuan Yaomuhu'er's following was granted 15,000 ingots of notes.

s0091.literal: That month Bianliang, Dadu, and Hejian suffered flooding; Longxing, Pingluan, Datong, and Xuande and other routes suffered hail.
s0091.idiomatic: That month Bianliang, Dadu, and Hejian suffered flooding; Longxing, Pingluan, Datong, and Xuande and other routes suffered hail.

s0092.literal: Ninth month, on guimao day, the Birthday Festival: the court halted at Gu Zha and received congratulations from princes and officials of all ranks.
s0092.idiomatic: Ninth month, on guimao day, the Birthday Festival: the court halted at Gu Zha and received congratulations from princes and officials of all ranks.

s0093.literal: On gengyin day the Hedong-Shanxi iron smelting intendancy was established.
s0093.idiomatic: On gengyin day the Hedong-Shanxi iron smelting intendancy was established.

s0094.literal: On renchen day a meteor of red color, its tail more than one zhang in length, its light illuminating the ground, rose from River Drum and set west of Ox; there was a sound like thunder.
s0094.idiomatic: On renchen day a meteor of red color, its tail more than one zhang in length, its light illuminating the ground, rose from River Drum and set west of Ox; there was a sound like thunder.

s0095.literal: On guisi day the registration of Song hand-number troops was abolished.
s0095.idiomatic: On guisi day the registration of Song hand-number troops was abolished.

s0096.literal: On yiwei day the moon encroached upon the angular star of Mao.
s0096.idiomatic: On yiwei day the moon encroached upon the angular star of Mao.

s0097.literal: On dingyou day Venus encroached upon the Left Enforcer.
s0097.idiomatic: On dingyou day Venus encroached upon the Left Enforcer.

s0098.literal: On jihai day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.
s0098.idiomatic: On jihai day the imperial carriage returned to Dadu.

s0099.literal: Yangzhou and Huai'an suffered drought; their field rents were remitted.
s0099.idiomatic: Yangzhou and Huai'an suffered drought; their field rents were remitted.

s0100.literal: Winter, tenth month, on wushen new moon there were ceremonies at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0100.idiomatic: Winter, tenth month, on wushen new moon there were ceremonies at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
